name: Strength of Mount Mugamba
label: Quest
description: Strength of Mount Mugamba: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: It is good to see you in good health, friend. The glorious battles you have undertaken affect all life on this planet. Hakkar must never leave the confines of Zul'Gurub as the world will surely collapse beneath his immense hunger.
Give me your talisman and I shall amplify its strength. Use the Strength of Mugamba to punish our enemies!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Our paths will cross again, adventurer.
